title: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia - 5x09 - Mac and Dennis Break Up
sourceFilename: It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia - 5x09 - Mac and Dennis Break Up.en.srt

lines.text: Sweet Dee, Sweet Dee, Sweet Dee, Sweet Dee, Sweet Dee, Sweet Dee!
I got a cat, so what?
You've begun your transformation into "Crazy Cat Lady."
I just, I just got a cat 'cause I wanted something to hang out with.
I don't have, you know, a roommate or anything.
I don't really have anyone to talk to, so I...
If you listen to yourself, you would realize you're only strengthening our argument.
We need a big bowl for popcorn.
You guys don't have a bowl?
Uh, we don't have a big one, no.
Why'd you guys have to both come over here to get one bowl?
It's more fun if we both come.
Yeah, I was gonna hold the bowl, Dennis was gonna stand next to me and make snide comments.
Uh, oh, you look like a bird.
Eh, old, make a new one.
You know, he comes up with good ones.
I know, that was a good one.
I don't understand why you can't make snide remarks and hold a bowl at the same time, though.
You're fixating too much on the bowl aspect of it.
If the two of us didn't come together, what if one of us were to get into a jam?
It'd be silly not to have the other one there.
See, you'll never get out of a jam because you got no friends.
It's funny 'cause I feel like you guys are two codependent losers who are so wrapped up in each other that it's hard for you to see how pathetic your lives are.
It's like you're an old married couple.
We're more like a dynamic duo.
So, you don't think that two 30-year-old men who spend every waking moment together is a little bit pathetic?
We don't spend every waking moment together.
When's the last time you went more than an hour without seeing each other?
Without checking... that's... he always checks in with me.
He likes to have me check in.
She doesn't know anything about friendship, dude.
Yeah, but you weren't answering any of my calls.
I've been, I've been calling you sort of over and over again.
I was having a conversation with the video store clerk.
Yeah, but I texted you 911, dude.
Well, I couldn't get in touch with you, dude.
That's a bit of an overreaction.
I was gone for what, an hour?
Yeah, but I thought we had a deal.
You know, you would check in every once in a while and then that way I would know that you were okay.
Uh, I'm sorry, can we watch the movie?
I know you wanted to see Predator again but I feel like we've seen that 30 times in the last two months and thought maybe we could mix things up.
Video store clerk guy said this movie's awesome, so...
I feel like you won't stop talking about him.
I asked him for a movie recommendation, okay?
It's really not that big of a deal.
Well, the big deal, Dennis, is that I wasn't even consulted on the decision, okay?
And this is a big deal to me, as well.
We haven't seen Transporter 1 which means we'll be completely lost...
Plus, Jason Statham's physique is nothing like the line-up in Predator.
I don't want to have conversations anymore about dudes' physiques and whether they can...
That's what I was trying to avoid.
A conversation about body mass, okay?

We've had that conversation five times a day for the last month because we keep watching Predator and all you talk about is Weathers and Jesse "The Body" Ventura and how many pounds they can pack on...
It's important to pack on mass.
I don't want to, I don't want to have this conversation with you anymore.
No, you'd rather have conversations with video store clerks.
You know what, man, if you don't wanna watch the movie with me, that's fine.
I will watch it by myself.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, where is this coming from?
I have been thinking a lot about what Dee said and I do think...
....maybe we are spending a little bit too much time together.
I'm saying that I feel like we're in a little bit of a rut and... I feel like I'm not flourishing.
Well, far be it from me to, uh, keep the flower of you from flourishing.
But, uh, I guess I'll grab my shit and stay at Charlie's.
I feel like I'm the one that got us into this mess.
Okay, so you'll stay at Charlie's then.
You should stay there because you already said that you would.
It'll take me longer to pack and it'll be easier.
Hi, I'm responding to a missing persons report.
I came to hang out with you.
I thought it was movie night.
Yeah, it is movie night but, uh, Mac and I are taking a little bit of a break.
I was thinking about what you were saying-- you were right.
I wasn't spending enough time by myself.
I wasn't being an independent individual.
So, let's watch a movie together, you and me.
Yeah, I'm kind of in the middle of something with my cat right now.
Let's bring him into the mix.
He is in the wall somewhere.
Yeah, I think he got into the wall.
Well, that's a bummer, but I'm sure he'll come out at some some point.
Got himself in there, I'm sure he'll get himself out.
And he'll die in there and you'll have a dead cat smell for a while.
But listen, I'm gonna help you out of that jam.
Open the windows and get some scented candles going, maybe get a big fan in here and then he'll decompose and everything will be fine-- boom!
That's what it's like to have a sidekick.
Helped you out of a jam.
In the meantime, let's watch a movie.
Just wanna watch a movie with you.
Why don't you just put your trash into a trash can?
I put it in the trash can when I'm ready to take it outside, dude.
Yeah, but you could skip a step by first putting it into the can.
And you can shut the hell up, man.
Okay-- and Jesus Christ, Frank, are you cutting your toenails with a steak knife?
Oh, I suppose you have a problem with that, too.
I need some trash to plug up the cut.
Do not plug an open wound with trash.
Oh, don't waste a good sock on a tiny little cut.
I'll find you a candy wrapper if you give me a second.
It's acting like a cut glove.
There are so many things that are going to need to change now that I'm living here, okay?
Well, you know, he's got some good ideas.
Maybe it wouldn't be bad if he moved in.
I could use a little structure in my life here.
I mean, look at all the trash all over the place.
I don't know who it is.
Are you going to answer it?
I'm just going to get it.
Oh, Mac is being annoying as shit.
He bossing you around a whole bunch?
He didn't say anything at all about me or...?
Did you call me just to talk about Mac, okay?
Because I don't want to talk about Mac with you.
Tell him I'm not talking about him.
Tell him I'm not talking about him at all.
I'm not telling him shit, dude.
I'm going to hang up the phone on you.
No, no, Charlie, don't hang up the phone-- no!
I didn't call to talk about Mac.
I could care less about that guy.
Wanted to see if you wanted to come over to Dee's apartment.
I am so excited to watch this movie without Mac.
He's always constantly critiquing the fight scenes and talking about how he could choreograph the fight scenes so much better than they could, which is ridiculous.
Dee, will you forget the goddamn cat for a second and listen to all the interesting things I have to say?
You're being the worst sidekick right now.
No, you're being the worst sidekick.
I thought sidekicks were supposed to help each other out of jams.
Right, I did help you out of a jam.
I told you what to do with your dead stinking cat.
No, no, no, no, come on.
Peel this apple for me, please.
No, I'm not going to peel an apple for you.
But Mac always does it for me.
Why does Mac peel your apples for you?
He doesn't like for me to eat the apples with the skin on it.
He says the skin's loaded with toxins.
I know he's not here, and that's why I need you to do it for me, please, please.
Just eat it with the skin on it.
I do not like it with the skin, Dee!
I'm not allowed to eat it with the skin!
If you just shut up, I will peel the apple for you the way that Mac likes you to eat it.
I'll do it the way that Mac insists, okay?
Hey, you want a skinless apple, bud?
You can peel your own apple, Charlie.
She's in a little bit of a mood because her cat got stuck in the wall.
Okay, now you're talking my language.
All right, catch me up to speed here-- what do we got?
You're putting Cheeto fingers all over the wall.
What's the point of entry here?
I've been looking all around this goddamn place.
I bet it flattened itself out, went right through a seam in your wall.
I don't think there's anything in the laws of nature that would support that.
Cats do not abide by the laws of nature, right?
Hey, we're still going to watch the movie, right, man?
I think it's stuck in there.
All right, let's focus on what's happening with the cat, all right?
It made a conscious decision to go in your wall, correct?
It chose to be in there.
It wants to be in your wall, Dee.
Thinking about getting some catnip, and I was going to...
No, no, no, don't do that.
It's going to know that's a trap, Dee, okay?
That's going to irritate the cat, and then it's going to dig itself down further.
We may never get to it, okay?
Let's start thinking like a cat here, all right?
You know, we... we need another cat.
Here's what we're going to do.
I'm going to crack a little hole in your wall.
And then I'm going to slip a second cat in with a string tied around it.
Then I'll rip the second cat out, and the first one hopefully-- hopefully!-- will follow.
I don't mean to keep bugging you, but you didn't tell me what to do.
Do you want me to start it now, or you want me to wait?
But I want to watch it with you-- I mean, I will wait.
Just start the movie, man, 'cause I'm having a conversation here!
All right, where are we going to get this other cat?
Oh, I can get you another cat.
I got followed here by, like, ten cats.
Yeah, they're starting to follow me these days.
I... you know, I don't want you to miss the setup.
All the groceries, no cat food.
And I bumped into that guy at the video store.
Huh? You did a great job.
The skin of those things is riddled with toxins.
Yeah... (groans) Yeah, get it out, though.
Whew! That was a close call.
Well, don't touch me with it.
Hey, also, I cleaned out this closet.
I'm telling you, bro, we could fit a mattress in there.
You and Charlie don't have to sleep next to each other anymore.
Well, I... I kind of liked the other arrangement, though.
Yeah, the other arrangement was... was not pretty good.
It was, um... it was, uh...
What... uh, what's the word I'm looking for?
Whoa, what... what are you doing now, dude?
What? I'm taking the toxic skin off.
Yeah, but you're cutting it with your toe knife.
What... what are you talking about?
Wait, you're throwing my toe knife out?
Because you were cutting your fruit with it.
What the hell's going on here?

Look, Mac-- I mean, look, I-I think the cleaning up and throwing the trash away is good, but the-- you know, the sleeping arrangements and the plastic and throwing the toe knife out the window-- that's-- I'm not gonna put on airs just because I got company.
So, you think not eating cat food is putting on airs?
Look, I gotta take a walk.
Just make sure you, you know, check in, 'cause I haven't heard from Charlie and it is getting late.
This little lady is a calico cat.
I'm gonna pop this little girl in your wall here, she's gonna meet your little fella...
....they're gonna bond, and then I'm gonna rip her out and he's gonna come right afterwards.
It's all part of the dance.
I knew I should've gotten a bird.
What are you gonna do with a bird?
Should I make myself throw up?
Apple seeds, man, that's no good.
So, uh, how's life with Mac?
There is always room for you, bud.
Give it to me. Give it to me.
Guys, guys, I can't throw up.
Should I stick a finger down my throat?
Oh, my God, you guys we gotta...
Oh, my-- we gotta get Mac and Dennis back together, okay?
Because they are ruining all of our lives.
I got two cats stuck inside this wall, can't get 'em out.
You want to bring in a third?
Hey, just, Frank, get out of here-- you're making it worse.
We work very well together, okay.
All right, I'm gonna go and get Mac and Dennis back together.
I'm gonna get two cats out of my wall, then I'm going to go back to being alone.
Can you part for one second?
He swallowed some apple apple seeds.
I was told I'd be meeting a woman with giant breasts.
I was also told that I was to meet a woman with giant breasts.
Yes, geniuses, I set you up.
Now, can you please make up?
Look, I'm sorry that I called you codependent, okay.
I think you have a great friendship and it's perfectly natural for two grown men to need each other this badly.
All right, I guess I should...
You're not-- neither one of you are ever going into my apartment ever again, okay?
So, make up, don't make up, kill each other-- I don't care.
I need to go get a bird.
I swallowed some apple seeds today.
Did you make yourself throw up?
The smoke will suffocate the bacteria in your stomach.
The way they live, bro, it's... it's like, um...
I've been trying to come up with that all day.
God, dude, this is why you and I are-are such a good team.
You know, like, I'm a man of action and you're a man that comes up with good...
You really gotta work on your vocabulary, though, man.
You couldn't think of the word "words."
And not that it concerns you.
Now might be a good time for you to pay your bill and leave.
Well, you're not making sense 'cause we didn't buy anything.
Actually, I-I had a couple of rum and Cokes.
Yeah, I was nervous about the big-breasted lady.
I-I was nervous about her, too.
Dee said she had giant boobs.
Will that be, uh, cash or charge?
I also was assuming that the big-breasted lady was gonna pay for the drinks.
So, I don't have any money.
I can-- I can get you out of this jam.
What the hell is going on?
Yeah, we're bashing a bigger hole in your wall.
We're gonna stuff all the cats in at one time.
No more big holes in my wall, no more cats.
I tied a string around his teeny tiny little legs, I'm sending it in.
You're gonna toss a bird in?
I'm gonna toss the bird in, Charlie.
Go ahead, Dee, toss the bird in.
Go on, you got it, you got it.
Whoa, oh, hold on, hold on, hold on, guy-- I gotcha.
You have some very satisfied cats in there, okay?
Now, will you step aside and let the men do the work?
I got it from here, all right?
I'm bashing a hole in my wall, I'm going in myself.
Get the hell out of the way.
I'm dead serious, I'm going in.
I'm gonna get you, you cat!
Whoa, there are a lot of cats back here!
Yeah, we put a lot of cats in there.
Ah, the dynamic duo in effect.
You guys, I think I'm stuck in the wall.
That's why she needs a friend.
I'm trying to back out, but my shirt's caught on something.
Guys? Guys? Guys, come on! www.tvsubtitles.net
